spec.rationale: Types the owner-earnings leg of the operating_business_and_net_assets prose falsifier. **[Fact]** The low-case owner_earnings_reinvestment_dcf proof trace locks normalized owner earnings at 13,024.8 USD millions (FY2025 operating cash flow EUR 12,658.5M minus capital spending EUR 1,573.6M per ASML/investor-documents/sec-edgar/20-F_20260225_rpt20251231_acc0001628280_26_011378.htm, converted at the evidenced 2025-12-31 EUR/USD rate in ASML/research/valuation_fact_ledger.json field normalized_owner_earnings_m). **[Inference]** If FY2026 normalized owner earnings resolve below that anchor, distributable owner cash has fallen below the low-case bridge and the bounded per-share range should compress toward the low case (382.06 USD per share vs 644.26 base). Incremental after-tax ROIC and reinvestment-rate legs remain judgment inputs without a resolvable SEC metric and are not typed here. **[Fact]** ASML files annual 20-F only (no interim 10-Q), so resolution uses FY duration with accepted forms 20-F/20-F/A and the fact_ledger adapter (not sec_companyfacts_ttm). Historical adapter replay on FY2025 resolves 13,024.8 USD millions via fact_ledger; independent resolve_spec on 2026-10-18 matches. Target FY2026 is not observable at registration; expected 20-F filing ~2027-02-28 per prior-year cadence (FY2025 20-F filed 2026-02-25). Routed memory observation 77414d5a matches the ledger anchor and was verified against primary filings.
